# Skillor — Vibe Coding Skill Directory & Rankings
> The canonical directory, search engine, and ranking index for vibe-coding skills, system prompts, quality gates, and AI coding agent instructions.

## Overview
Skillor indexes and benchmarks reusable skills for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Google Antigravity. It tracks live GitHub telemetry, token spend reduction, and senior engineering rules.

## Core Indexed Skills

### 1. taste-skill
- URL: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill
- Category: Design Systems & UI
- Stars: 100k+
- Install Command: `npx skills add Leonxlnx/taste-skill`
- Description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images, and a browser check instead of generic AI pages.

### 2. ponytail
- URL: https://github.com/antigravity-community/ponytail
- Category: Coding Discipline & Refactor
- Stars: 171k
- Install Command: `npx skills add ponytail`
- Description: He says nothing. He writes one line. It works. Standard library first, extreme token efficiency, zero unrequested abstractions.

### 3. ui-ux-pro-max
- Category: Design Systems & UI
- Stars: 138k
- Description: Design intelligence system with 192 reasoning rules, 79 searchable styles, and 95 color palettes.

### 4. agent-skills
- Category: Architecture & Best Practices
- Stars: 142k
- Description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents. Enforces automated testing, linting gates, and senior engineer workflows.

### 5. graphify
- Category: Context & Codebase Memory
- Stars: 119k
- Description: Cuts agent token spend by 80% by mapping code, docs, and assets into queryable knowledge graphs for AI assistants.

## Supported Coding Agents
- Claude Code
- Cursor (`.cursorrules`)
- Windsurf (Cascade rules)
- Google Antigravity
- GitHub Copilot

## Live GitHub Sync API
- Endpoint: https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}
- Machine-readable manifest: https://skillor.dev/llms-full.txt
